title: Debug nil map panic and concurrent write race in Go — 3 turns
description: Go map operations panic on nil map write. Fix nil map initialization, fix concurrent write race, confirm all tests pass.

task_spec.prompt: The `Store` in `store/store.go` panics on `Set` because `data` is nil (never initialized in `New()`). Fix `New()` to initialize `data` with `make(map[string]string)`. Then run `go test ./...`.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what you fixed. Now also fix `Set()` — it writes to the map without holding the mutex, which will cause a data race in the concurrent test. Add `s.mu.Lock()/s.mu.Unlock()` around the map write. Run `go test -race ./...` to confirm no races.
Final verification: run `go test -race ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
success_criteria: New() initializes data map with make()
Set() holds mutex before writing to map
go test -race ./... reports no data races
